name: Demyan
desc: A bartender of "The Flagship" in Nasha Town.

value.name: Guide to Elysium
value.desc:
Talent Level-Up material.
"Elysium" is the dream of the land beneath the moon.
To create a paradise without borders or distinctions upon a land overflowing with bitterness and sorrow — though it might be but a childish delusion, it may yet be a foundation for the future.

customize.name: Berries and Fried Meat
customize.desc: Fried meat accompanied by mashed potatoes. The meat is thinly sliced, fried, then stewed, before being laid atop a bed of mashed potatoes. Usually eaten with crushed berries. Nutritious and filling!

customize.name: Mora
customize.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

customize.name: Roulette Special
customize.desc: Colorful drinks. It might be more accurate to call this a table game than nourishment of any sort, one where the rules are to drink whatever drink the pointer falls on. Demyan has modified the drinks to differ from The Flagship's usual offerings — all of them are alcohol-free and rather sweet.

customize.name: Mora

customize.name: Piramida Nightingale
customize.desc: A drink whose colors are clear and elegant — this one does not appear to contain any alcohol. Legend has it that the Torchforger, Solovei, once gifted someone a nightingale, and that moment served as the inspiration for this drink. Now, only the nightingale's song remains, lingering amid the tranquil night.

customize.name: Mora
customize.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

customize.name: Frontier Land
customize.desc: A layered drink of shifting shades — this one does not appear to contain any alcohol. The inspiration for this concoction is said to be Nod-Krai itself, with an initial icy chill that gives way to smoky, astringent notes. It's worth noting that the alcoholic version of this drink is a daily staple for many of the region's veteran adventurers.

customize.name: Wildberry Trail
customize.desc: A layered drink of different colors — this one does not appear to contain any alcohol. Incorporating two of Nod-Krai's signature berries, its vibrant colors feel light and cheerful, as if you're strolling down a path through a fertile orchard.
